violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no CFM present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Multiple employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ANY EMPLOYEE PREPPING FOOD MUST HAVE THEIR HAIR RESTRAINED TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION. PIC MADE EMPLOYEES PULL HAIR BACK AND PUT ON HATS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PLEASE OBTAIN A HIGH TEMP DISH MACHINE TEST KIT.
